newsitem.title: GERMANY: Timetable for Deutsche Telekom IPO.
newsitem.headline: Timetable for Deutsche Telekom IPO.

text.p: Here is a timetable of events leading up to official trade in shares of Deutsche Telekom AG in November.
The bookbuilding phase began on October 22. Telekom has set the price range for bookbuilding at 25 to 30 marks.

-- Nov 6: Last day of acceptance of purchase orders for private investors who previously registered with Deutsche Telekom's share information centre and want to be eligible for a discount of 50 pfennigs per share.
-- Nov 14: Last day of acceptance of purchase orders in the German Offering and end of the bookbuilding period.
-- Date still to be set: Subscription of shares by the global coordinators (excluding optional shares).
-- Nov 16/17: Determination of the offer price per share.
-- Nov 17/18: Final allocation, public announcement of the offer price per share and the allocation formula for German retail investors.
-- Nov 18: Commencement of trading of shares on German stock exchanges and of American Depositary Shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
-- Nov 19: Commencement of trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
-- Nov 20/21: Settlement for the offered shares and for trades made on the first trading day
NOTE - Deutsche Telekom said the above dates are subject to change.
